items.name: dacat.2years
items.description:
dacat.2years

Pages of an old explorer’s journal flip open and there, on the giant glowing 2, a ringmaster daCAT stands tall, grin wide, surrounded by the whole clowder losing their minds in celebration. Two full years since the token launch. The real genesis block birthday. The ride’s only getting wilder. Happy 2nd, daCAT fam.

dacat.heritage

Every story has roots... and ours is only getting started
